column1: # Purchase notices dated January 2024 to June 2025, the window a search of Nov 25, 2026 covered (web searches of national and provincial procurement sites and of buyers' own sites, and a search by whole word of the project's saved procurement pages for H20, H800, A800 and L20), that name the H20, H800, A800, L20 or Nvidia: 34 rows, made on Nov 25, 2026. Columns as in tables/procurement_records.tsv. Column part: n = a notice new to the project when it was found, read whole in its saved copy (12 rows; two of them, the tender and the award of the University of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, are in tables/procurement_records.tsv since Nov 25, 2026); n-img = new, a scanned page without a text layer, read by eye from its rendered image and read a second time the same way; its words are checked by script against the transcription kept beside the scan, not against a text layer (1 row); n-filing = a company's filing with its exchange, NOT a purchase notice (1 row); held = a notice the project already held, whose hardware words were found again by script and not read again (20 rows); their project, quantity, value and cuts are in the tenders note's table, outputs/A12_tenders_and_provinces/idea35_tenders/notices.tsv. The home_made column also says what the page says on imports. An award or a result is a contract decision, not a delivery and not an import. Notices that a search reported and whose pages could not be saved are not rows. One page stands in tables/procurement_notices_sweep.tsv too (the Fudan University award, cn-ga31-h20notices-4), and that table's notices of the Agricultural Development Bank (cn-ga31-h20notices-22), Soochow University (cn-ga31-unsaved3-noticecopies5-suda, which names the H20) and the Bank of Jiangsu (cn-ga31-unsaved3-noticecopies20) are of the same months; nothing is merged.
